name: Tyrannomon
main_effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] For the turn, when this Digimon would digivolve into a card with [Tyrannomon] in its name, or the [Dinosaur] or [Ceratopsian] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
source_effect: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Tyrannomon] in its name, or the [Dinosaur] or [Ceratopsian] trait, it may attack.
